selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether the existing human APR-246/AEC signal admits a small, interpretable existing-article qualification route, or instead requires major article/model/rights development
selection.basis: User-directed priority from independent conditional marginal-capital review, tested against fresh clinical, article, model and rights evidence

independent_review.read_scope: All ten pages through the connected file text reader
independent_review.kind: independent analytical review supplied in the user context; not primary experimental evidence
independent_review.objective: Discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after remaining development/commercial costs, rights, royalties, partner sharing and dilution

decision: Retain APR-246/AEC as first conditional marginal-dollar qualification priority; close this public-source sprint; no full program or spending commitment.
scientific_tier: existing local translational challenger; no S-tier promotion
intended_claim: Clinically useful sustained control of persistent AEC erosions and treatment burden during the intended regimen, at acceptable local/systemic exposure

completed_evidence_gains.gain: Two later primary abstracts reconciled to original two children; added sole/site/pain details and preserved P2 variant conflict
Patent composition example agrees with historical concentration statements; per-site amount and stability transfer remain unresolved
Two 2026 model/functional-comparator papers identify existing routes with expression, timing, genotype and access limits
Current company filing distinguishes no ongoing company trials from maintained rights and closeout spending
Current ongoing-control claim supersedes APR-specific universal withdrawal/cornification gate without rewriting prior packages

model_routes.title: A Novel Model System to Identify Cellular and Molecular Defects Underlying Rare Genetic Disorders
model_routes.read_scope: Primary PubMed abstract and Figure 1–2 legends; complete article/supplement not recovered
model_routes.model: Engineered NTERT keratinocytes and 3D epidermal equivalents
findings: Approximately 1:1 mutant:WT TP63, with total TP63 approximately twice nontransduced cells
Reduced cell-ECM adhesion to collagen IV/fibronectin in reported comparisons
model_routes.interpretation: A specific existing-model lead; not evidence that a new platform must be built or that this platform is ready to decide topical APR benefit.

model_routes.title: Therapeutic p63 isoform switching rescues epidermal defects in AEC syndrome
model_routes.read_scope: Complete 19-page institutional article text available; focused assessment of Figure 6/results and sheet-assay context. Supplement not independently audited.
model_routes.locator: Institutional PDF article pages 9–11, Figure 6; methods page 16
findings: Genetic exon-13 deletion shifted isoforms and reduced aggregation in patient-derived cultures
I537T sheets generated from edited cultures showed restored mechanical cohesion relative to mutant control
model_routes.interpretation: Functional responsiveness of a patient-cell phenotype to a different intervention supports a possible comparator/readout; it is not topical APR evidence or a required gene-editing program.

routes.name: Existing-article / existing-model qualification
routes.scientific_question: Can the article and interpretable tissue-function evidence support or reject a useful ongoing-control product at small scope?

routes.name: Appropriate controlled clinical-development route
routes.scientific_question: Can meaningful lesion and care-burden benefit be causally demonstrated against appropriate care with acceptable exposure?

routes.name: Major product/model/rights program
routes.scientific_question: Does a materially larger project still beat the next feasible alternative after costs and capture?

branches.condition: Existing article and an appropriate already available functional model can support a consequential, interpretable question within a genuinely small scope
branches.decision: Retain APR as first conditional qualification priority

branches.condition: An informative approved clinical-development route is more valuable than additional model work after article/exposure and governance needs are addressed
branches.decision: Do not require an automatic preclinical reset; assess that route on its actual separate cost and requirements

branches.condition: Useful progress requires major new vehicle/chemistry, model construction or costly/inaccessible rights
branches.decision: End the assumed small tranche and compare revised cost/information/capture against RM4404, BLU and waiting; do not automatically extend scope

branches.condition: Later credible evidence shows no worthwhile benefit versus appropriate care, unacceptable exposure, or no useful tissue function for the intended claim
branches.decision: Stop or narrow the corresponding product claim; distinguish failed repair claim from an independently supported symptom-control claim

branches.condition: Useful patient benefit remains but ddiscov cannot retain adequate value after rights, reach and remaining costs
branches.decision: Do not represent patient evidence as an owned financial asset; defer, redirect or separately justify an evidence/public-benefit route

decision_inputs_remaining: Model fit and obtainable access, if a model route is chosen
Causal useful benefit and chronic safety
Reachable AEC patients, realistic adoption and economics

reopen_only_for: Substantive new patient/site/dose or transcript correction
New exact-article stability, skin-exposure or controlled clinical evidence
Accessible substantive model fit/access documentation or official claim record
Defined product or transaction facts changing a specific marginal commitment
